name: action-initialization-2026-10-19
hypothesis: Protective-action mean initialization and Gaussian exploration may contribute to poor PPO exposure and churn. Use a 2x2 factorial screen to separate the factors; do not assume either helps.
selection_metric: Equal-weight mean validation net return, unchanged

screen_gate.ranking: Final equal-weight mean return; tie order low_noise, wide, wide_low_noise
screen_gate.scope: Promote at most one arm versus freshly rerun standard control; both stock and ETF groups must improve or tie on final return. Declining-stock labels never select or promote.

initialization.native_action_weights: Preserve seeded weights, optimizer and all other parameters
initialization.signed_exposure_and_shorting: Unchanged; no long bias or sign constraint

constraints.features_actions_costs_reward: Unchanged basic features, target-zone-v1, default simulator, net log equity
constraints.short_side: Reconciled reporting on all symbols; ex-post negative-holding stock labels are reporting-only
constraints.success_claim: Development promotion is not independent confirmation or permission to trade

execution.preflight: 512-transition CPU smoke of each distinct initialization before research
execution.cleanup: Retrieve and validate artifacts; verify owned teardown; retain selected/final weights and curves; publish checksums before removing duplicates
